SELECT ROUND(1.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer), 2) AS mean_invoices_per_customer

SELECT DISTINCT ar.Name AS artist_name FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId WHERE i.CustomerId = 12 ORDER BY ar.Name ASC

SELECT ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue_usd FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden'
